note: 30 candidates in this part. The session's shared web-search allowance was already used up (200 of 200) when this part began, so no search engine could be asked; pages were found by following links from county, city, court and school-district sites, read with WebFetch and the kit's own fetcher (states/net.py). No campaign website could be found without search. Many county sites did not resolve (Mercer, Union's fiscal court page answered 403, Johnson, Robertson, Pendleton, the City of Lyndon) or carry no member list (Fayette); Green County Schools' certificate is self-signed and was not read; Boone County Schools' board page loads its members by script. Incumbents checked and found to be someone else: Nelson District 5 (Jon Snow), Woodford District 3 (Darrell Varner), Marion District 2 (Larry Mattingly; the page is marked 2022), Lawrence District 4 (the county's page is stale), Richmond's commission (Krystin Arnold is not a sitting commissioner). Holloway and Dossett are sitting legislators with record pages; their party listings are already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json, as are Brian D. Smith's and John Andrew Sosby's. Hopkinsville's council page lists 'Marie Hughes' for Ward 5, the seat Carolyn Marie Hughes seeks; the page's contact numbers were not recorded. Logan County's magistrate page carries family and schooling details, which were not recorded. Verifier (2026-10-03): every url re-opened; all eight findings confirmed as recorded (the PVA directory, too large for WebFetch, was read with the kit's fetcher and only its Pendleton name line looked at; the Montgomery board page with net.py after WebFetch's lookup failed).
